desc: Implement the stack-based simulation: process slimes left to right, maintain stack of (size, left_index). For each A[i], start with cur_size=A[i], cur_l=i. While stack and cur_size > stack[-1][0]: merge by popping top, cur_size += popped_size, cur_l = popped_left. If stack and stack[-1][0] > cur_size: absorb cur into top: pop top, cur_size += popped_size, cur_l = popped_left, continue loop. Push (cur_size, cur_l) onto stack.

After processing all slimes, the stack contains the final components. Assign answer B[K] = size of component containing K, where component i covers indices from left_index to (next component's left_index - 1) or N-1.
Verify with sample 1 and sample 2 to ensure output matches exactly.
Ensure the algorithm runs in O(N) time and O(N) memory, handling N up to 5e5.
